CREATE TABLE profiles (
                id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
                email TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
                name TEXT NOT NULL,
                headline TEXT,
                location TEXT,
                about TEXT,
                profile_photo TEXT,
                banner_color TEXT DEFAULT '#0A66C2',
                industry TEXT DEFAULT '',
                school TEXT DEFAULT '',
                current_company_slug TEXT DEFAULT '',
                connection_degree TEXT DEFAULT '1st',
                followers_count INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
                canonical_id TEXT
            );
CREATE TABLE sqlite_sequence(name,seq);
CREATE TABLE experience (
                id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
                profile_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES profiles(id),
                title TEXT NOT NULL,
                company TEXT NOT NULL,
                location TEXT,
                start_date TEXT NOT NULL,
                end_date TEXT,
                description TEXT,
                is_current INTEGER DEFAULT 0
            );
CREATE TABLE education (
                id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
                profile_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES profiles(id),
                school TEXT NOT NULL,
                degree TEXT,
                field_of_study TEXT,
                start_year INTEGER,
                end_year INTEGER,
                description TEXT
            );
CREATE TABLE skills (
                id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
                profile_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES profiles(id),
                name TEXT NOT NULL,
                endorsement_count INTEGER DEFAULT 0
            );
CREATE TABLE connections (
                id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
                profile_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES profiles(id),
                connected_profile_id INTEGER,
                connected_name TEXT NOT NULL,
                connected_headline TEXT,
                connected_email TEXT,
                connection_degree TEXT DEFAULT '1st',
                connected_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now')),
                canonical_id TEXT
            );
CREATE TABLE posts (
                id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
                user_email TEXT NOT NULL,
                author_name TEXT NOT NULL,
                author_headline TEXT,
                author_type TEXT DEFAULT 'person',
                company_slug TEXT,
                company_name TEXT,
                content TEXT NOT NULL,
                link_url TEXT,
                post_type TEXT DEFAULT 'text',
                image_url TEXT,
                document_title TEXT,
                document_pages INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
                document_url TEXT,
                article_title TEXT,
                article_source TEXT,
                article_description TEXT,
                article_image_url TEXT,
                likes INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
                comments_count INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
                impressions INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
                edited_at TEXT,
                canonical_id TEXT,
                date TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now'))
            );
CREATE TABLE companies (
                id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
                slug TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
                name TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
                description TEXT NOT NULL,
                industry TEXT NOT NULL,
                location TEXT NOT NULL,
                employee_count INTEGER NOT NULL,
                website TEXT,
                banner_color TEXT DEFAULT '#0A66C2',
                logo_text TEXT DEFAULT '',
                followers_count INTEGER DEFAULT 0
            );
CREATE TABLE post_comments (
                id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
                post_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES posts(id),
                user_email TEXT NOT NULL,
                author_name TEXT NOT NULL,
                body TEXT NOT NULL,
                created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now')),
                canonical_id TEXT
            );
CREATE TABLE post_poll_options (
                id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
                post_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES posts(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
                option_text TEXT NOT NULL,
                vote_count INTEGER DEFAULT 0
            );
CREATE TABLE post_poll_votes (
                id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
                post_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES posts(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
                option_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES post_poll_options(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
                user_email TEXT NOT NULL,
                created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now')),
                UNIQUE(post_id, user_email)
            );
CREATE TABLE messages (
                id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
                user_email TEXT NOT NULL,
                other_email TEXT NOT NULL,
                other_name TEXT NOT NULL,
                content TEXT NOT NULL,
                date TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now')),
                read INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
                is_outgoing INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
                attachment_name TEXT,
                attachment_type TEXT,
                attachment_url TEXT,
                canonical_id TEXT
            );
CREATE TABLE message_threads (
                id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
                user_email TEXT NOT NULL,
                other_email TEXT NOT NULL,
                other_name TEXT NOT NULL,
                archived INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
                muted INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
                deleted INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
                last_message_preview TEXT,
                last_date TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now')),
                UNIQUE(user_email, other_email)
            );
CREATE TABLE message_typing (
                id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
                user_email TEXT NOT NULL,
                other_email TEXT NOT NULL,
                actor TEXT NOT NULL,
                expires_at TEXT NOT NULL,
                UNIQUE(user_email, other_email, actor)
            );
CREATE TABLE jobs (
                id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
                title TEXT NOT NULL,
                company TEXT NOT NULL,
                company_slug TEXT,
                location TEXT NOT NULL,
                salary_range TEXT,
                employment_type TEXT DEFAULT 'Full-time',
                experience_level TEXT DEFAULT 'Mid-Senior',
                description TEXT,
                posted_date TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now')),
                is_saved INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
                applicant_count INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
                canonical_id TEXT
            );
CREATE TABLE resumes (
                id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
                user_email TEXT NOT NULL,
                name TEXT NOT NULL,
                file_name TEXT NOT NULL,
                focus_area TEXT,
                updated_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now'))
            );
CREATE TABLE job_application_questions (
                id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
                job_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES jobs(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
                question_text TEXT NOT NULL,
                question_type TEXT DEFAULT 'text',
                placeholder TEXT
            );
CREATE TABLE applications (
                id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
                job_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES jobs(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
                user_email TEXT NOT NULL,
                resume_name TEXT NOT NULL,
                resume_file_name TEXT,
                cover_letter TEXT,
                answers_json TEXT DEFAULT '[]',
                status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'submitted',
                current_stage TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'Application received',
                applied_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now')),
                updated_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now')),
                canonical_id TEXT,
                UNIQUE(job_id, user_email)
            );
CREATE TABLE application_status_history (
                id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
                application_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES applications(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
                status TEXT NOT NULL,
                label TEXT NOT NULL,
                created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now'))
            );
CREATE TABLE connection_requests (
                id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
                from_email TEXT NOT NULL,
                from_name TEXT NOT NULL,
                to_email TEXT NOT NULL,
                to_name TEXT NOT NULL,
                status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending',
                date TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now'))
            );
CREATE TABLE notifications (
                id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
                user_email TEXT NOT NULL,
                type TEXT NOT NULL,
                category TEXT DEFAULT 'all',
                message TEXT NOT NULL,
                read INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
                action_url TEXT,
                metadata TEXT DEFAULT '{}',
                date TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now'))
            );
CREATE TABLE notification_settings (
                id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
                user_email TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
                mentions_enabled INTEGER DEFAULT 1,
                jobs_enabled INTEGER DEFAULT 1,
                my_posts_enabled INTEGER DEFAULT 1,
                connections_enabled INTEGER DEFAULT 1,
                messages_enabled INTEGER DEFAULT 1
            );
CREATE TABLE profile_view_events (
                id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
                user_email TEXT NOT NULL,
                viewer_email TEXT,
                viewer_name TEXT NOT NULL,
                viewer_headline TEXT,
                viewed_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now'))
            );
CREATE TABLE profile_analytics_daily (
                id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
                user_email TEXT NOT NULL,
                metric TEXT NOT NULL,
                metric_date TEXT NOT NULL,
                value INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
                UNIQUE(user_email, metric, metric_date)
            );
CREATE TABLE message_thread_state (
                id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
                user_email TEXT NOT NULL,
                other_email TEXT NOT NULL,
                archived INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
                muted INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
                deleted INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
                last_read_message_id INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
                last_read_at TEXT,
                world_id TEXT,
                actor_id TEXT,
                vm_id TEXT,
                UNIQUE(user_email, other_email)
            );
CREATE TABLE notification_read_state (
                id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
                user_email TEXT NOT NULL,
                notification_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
                read INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
                updated_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now')),
                world_id TEXT,
                actor_id TEXT,
                vm_id TEXT,
                UNIQUE(user_email, notification_id)
            );
CREATE TABLE _seed_marker (key TEXT PRIMARY KEY, value TEXT NOT NULL);

CREATE TABLE bookings (
                id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
                canonical_booking_id TEXT,
                user_email TEXT NOT NULL,
                source_listing_id TEXT,
                catalog_source TEXT,
                property_name TEXT NOT NULL,
                property_type TEXT NOT NULL,
                location TEXT NOT NULL,
                address TEXT NOT NULL,
                host_name TEXT NOT NULL,
                check_in TEXT NOT NULL,
                check_out TEXT NOT NULL,
                guests INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
                total_price REAL NOT NULL,
                price_per_night REAL NOT NULL,
                status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'confirmed' CHECK(status IN ('confirmed', 'completed', 'cancelled', 'upcoming')),
                image_url TEXT,
                rating REAL,
                review TEXT,
                confirmation_code TEXT NOT NULL,
                amenities TEXT,
                cancellation_policy TEXT DEFAULT 'Flexible',
                created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
                world_id TEXT DEFAULT '',
                actor_id TEXT DEFAULT '',
                vm_id TEXT DEFAULT ''
            , updated_at TEXT);
CREATE TABLE sqlite_sequence(name,seq);
CREATE TABLE saved_properties (
                id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
                user_email TEXT NOT NULL,
                property_name TEXT NOT NULL,
                property_type TEXT NOT NULL,
                location TEXT NOT NULL,
                price_per_night REAL NOT NULL,
                rating REAL NOT NULL,
                review_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
                image_url TEXT,
                superhost INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
                saved_at TEXT NOT NULL,
                world_id TEXT DEFAULT '',
                actor_id TEXT DEFAULT '',
                vm_id TEXT DEFAULT ''
            );
CREATE TABLE search_results (
                id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
                source_listing_id TEXT,
                catalog_source TEXT,
                source_snapshot_date TEXT,
                source_url TEXT,
                property_name TEXT NOT NULL,
                property_type TEXT NOT NULL,
                location TEXT NOT NULL,
                neighborhood TEXT,
                city TEXT,
                state TEXT,
                price_per_night REAL NOT NULL,
                rating REAL NOT NULL,
                review_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
                image_url TEXT,
                superhost INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
                guests_max INTEGER DEFAULT 4,
                bedrooms INTEGER DEFAULT 1,
                beds INTEGER DEFAULT 1,
                bathrooms REAL DEFAULT 1,
                amenities TEXT,
                description TEXT,
                latitude REAL,
                longitude REAL,
                host_name TEXT,
                host_since TEXT,
                host_response_time TEXT,
                host_response_rate TEXT,
                world_id TEXT DEFAULT '',
                actor_id TEXT DEFAULT '',
                vm_id TEXT DEFAULT ''
            );
CREATE TABLE loyalty_programs (
                id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
                user_email TEXT NOT NULL,
                program_name TEXT NOT NULL,
                tier TEXT NOT NULL,
                member_id TEXT NOT NULL,
                points INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
                world_id TEXT DEFAULT '',
                actor_id TEXT DEFAULT '',
                vm_id TEXT DEFAULT ''
            );
CREATE TABLE booking_messages (
                id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
                canonical_message_key TEXT,
                booking_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
                user_email TEXT NOT NULL,
                sender_type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(sender_type IN ('guest', 'host')),
                sender_name TEXT NOT NULL,
                message TEXT NOT NULL,
                created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
                world_id TEXT DEFAULT '',
                actor_id TEXT DEFAULT '',
                vm_id TEXT DEFAULT ''
            );
CREATE TABLE _seed_marker (key TEXT PRIMARY KEY, value TEXT NOT NULL);
CREATE TABLE booking_events (
      id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
      booking_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES bookings(id),
      user_email TEXT NOT NULL,
      event_type TEXT NOT NULL,
      old_status TEXT,
      new_status TEXT,
      detail TEXT,
      created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ', 'now'))
    );
CREATE INDEX idx_bookings_user ON bookings(user_email);
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_bookings_canonical ON bookings(canonical_booking_id);
CREATE INDEX idx_bookings_identity ON bookings(property_name, location);
CREATE INDEX idx_bookings_source_identity
      ON bookings(catalog_source, source_listing_id)
      WHERE source_listing_id IS NOT NULL AND catalog_source IS NOT NULL;
CREATE INDEX idx_saved_user ON saved_properties(user_email);
CREATE INDEX idx_loyalty_user ON loyalty_programs(user_email);
CREATE INDEX idx_booking_messages_booking ON booking_messages(booking_id, created_at);
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_booking_messages_canonical_key
      ON booking_messages(canonical_message_key);
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_saved_unique ON saved_properties(user_email, property_name, location);
CREATE INDEX idx_booking_events_booking ON booking_events(booking_id, created_at);
CREATE INDEX idx_booking_events_user ON booking_events(user_email, created_at);
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_search_results_unique ON search_results(property_name, location);
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_search_results_source_unique
      ON search_results(catalog_source, source_listing_id)
      WHERE source_listing_id IS NOT NULL;

dinoco_schema:
CREATE TABLE loyalty (
                id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
                user_email TEXT NOT NULL,
                status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'Silver Medallion',
                miles INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
                miles_ytd INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
                medallion_qualifying_miles INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
                member_since TEXT NOT NULL,
                skymiles_number TEXT NOT NULL,
                world_id TEXT DEFAULT '',
                actor_id TEXT DEFAULT '',
                vm_id TEXT DEFAULT ''
            );
CREATE TABLE sqlite_sequence(name,seq);
CREATE TABLE flights (
                id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
                user_email TEXT NOT NULL,
                flight_number TEXT NOT NULL,
                origin TEXT NOT NULL,
                origin_city TEXT NOT NULL,
                destination TEXT NOT NULL,
                destination_city TEXT NOT NULL,
                departure_date TEXT NOT NULL,
                departure_time TEXT NOT NULL,
                arrival_date TEXT,
                arrival_time TEXT NOT NULL,
                status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'scheduled',
                seat TEXT,
                cabin_class TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'Economy',
                gate TEXT,
                terminal TEXT,
                aircraft TEXT,
                duration TEXT,
                miles_earned INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
                confirmation_code TEXT NOT NULL,
                checked_in INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
                operational_status TEXT DEFAULT 'On Time',
                delay_minutes INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
                status_message TEXT,
                estimated_departure_time TEXT,
                estimated_arrival_time TEXT,
                arrival_terminal TEXT,
                arrival_gate TEXT,
                boarding_zone TEXT,
                boarding_time TEXT,
                fare_paid INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
                last_modified_at TEXT,
                world_id TEXT DEFAULT '',
                actor_id TEXT DEFAULT '',
                vm_id TEXT DEFAULT ''
            , marketing_carrier TEXT, marketing_flight_number TEXT);
CREATE TABLE boarding_passes (
                id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
                flight_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
                user_email TEXT NOT NULL,
                passenger_name TEXT NOT NULL,
                barcode TEXT NOT NULL,
                qr_payload TEXT,
                boarding_group TEXT,
                boarding_position TEXT,
                tsa_precheck INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
                wallet_stub_label TEXT,
                issued_at TEXT NOT NULL,
                world_id TEXT DEFAULT '',
                actor_id TEXT DEFAULT '',
                vm_id TEXT DEFAULT '',
                FOREIGN KEY (flight_id) REFERENCES flights(id)
            );
CREATE TABLE passenger_profiles (
                id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
                user_email TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
                full_name TEXT NOT NULL,
                date_of_birth TEXT NOT NULL,
                gender TEXT NOT NULL,
                tsa_precheck INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
                passport_number TEXT NOT NULL,
                updated_at TEXT NOT NULL,
                world_id TEXT DEFAULT '',
                actor_id TEXT DEFAULT '',
                vm_id TEXT DEFAULT ''
            );
CREATE TABLE flight_passengers (
                id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
                flight_id INTEGER NOT NULL UNIQUE,
                user_email TEXT NOT NULL,
                full_name TEXT NOT NULL,
                date_of_birth TEXT NOT NULL,
                gender TEXT NOT NULL,
                tsa_precheck INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
                passport_number TEXT NOT NULL,
                world_id TEXT DEFAULT '',
                actor_id TEXT DEFAULT '',
                vm_id TEXT DEFAULT '',
                FOREIGN KEY (flight_id) REFERENCES flights(id)
            );
CREATE TABLE flight_baggage (
                id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
                flight_id INTEGER NOT NULL UNIQUE,
                user_email TEXT NOT NULL,
                checked_bag_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
                first_bag_free INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
                total_price INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
                world_id TEXT DEFAULT '',
                actor_id TEXT DEFAULT '',
                vm_id TEXT DEFAULT '',
                FOREIGN KEY (flight_id) REFERENCES flights(id)
            );
CREATE TABLE flight_seats (
                id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
                flight_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
                seat_number TEXT NOT NULL,
                cabin TEXT NOT NULL,
                row_number INTEGER NOT NULL,
                seat_letter TEXT NOT NULL,
                status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'available',
                world_id TEXT DEFAULT '',
                actor_id TEXT DEFAULT '',
                vm_id TEXT DEFAULT '',
                FOREIGN KEY (flight_id) REFERENCES flights(id)
            );
CREATE TABLE flight_alternatives (
                id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
                flight_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
                alternative_key TEXT,
                flight_number TEXT NOT NULL,
                departure_date TEXT NOT NULL,
                departure_time TEXT NOT NULL,
                arrival_date TEXT,
                arrival_time TEXT NOT NULL,
                estimated_departure_time TEXT NOT NULL,
                estimated_arrival_time TEXT NOT NULL,
                duration TEXT NOT NULL,
                aircraft TEXT NOT NULL,
                gate TEXT,
                terminal TEXT,
                arrival_gate TEXT,
                arrival_terminal TEXT,
                operational_status TEXT NOT NULL,
                delay_minutes INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
                status_message TEXT,
                fare_difference INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
                seats_left INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
                world_id TEXT DEFAULT '',
                actor_id TEXT DEFAULT '',
                vm_id TEXT DEFAULT '',
                FOREIGN KEY (flight_id) REFERENCES flights(id)
            );
CREATE TABLE flight_upgrades (
                id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
                flight_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
                upgrade_key TEXT,
                cabin_class TEXT NOT NULL,
                price_difference INTEGER NOT NULL,
                seat_hint TEXT,
                perks TEXT,
                status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'available',
                world_id TEXT DEFAULT '',
                actor_id TEXT DEFAULT '',
                vm_id TEXT DEFAULT '',
                FOREIGN KEY (flight_id) REFERENCES flights(id)
            );
CREATE TABLE payment_methods (
                id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
                user_email TEXT NOT NULL,
                cardholder_name TEXT NOT NULL,
                card_brand TEXT NOT NULL,
                last4 TEXT NOT NULL,
                exp_month TEXT NOT NULL,
                exp_year TEXT NOT NULL,
                billing_zip TEXT NOT NULL,
                is_default INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
                created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
                updated_at TEXT NOT NULL,
                world_id TEXT DEFAULT '',
                actor_id TEXT DEFAULT '',
                vm_id TEXT DEFAULT ''
            );
CREATE TABLE travel_credits (
                id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
                user_email TEXT NOT NULL,
                amount INTEGER NOT NULL,
                balance_remaining INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
                created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
                expires_at TEXT,
                source_booking_id INTEGER,
                redeemed INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
                world_id TEXT DEFAULT '',
                actor_id TEXT DEFAULT '',
                vm_id TEXT DEFAULT ''
            );
CREATE TABLE _seed_marker (key TEXT PRIMARY KEY, value TEXT NOT NULL);
CREATE INDEX idx_loyalty_user ON loyalty(user_email);
CREATE INDEX idx_flights_user ON flights(user_email);
CREATE INDEX idx_flights_date ON flights(departure_date);
CREATE INDEX idx_boarding_flight ON boarding_passes(flight_id);
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_boarding_flight_user ON boarding_passes(flight_id, user_email);
CREATE INDEX idx_passenger_profile_user ON passenger_profiles(user_email);
CREATE INDEX idx_flight_passengers_user ON flight_passengers(user_email);
CREATE INDEX idx_flight_baggage_user ON flight_baggage(user_email);
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_flight_seats_unique ON flight_seats(flight_id, seat_number);
CREATE INDEX idx_flight_alternatives_flight ON flight_alternatives(flight_id);
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_flight_alternatives_key
      ON flight_alternatives(alternative_key);
CREATE INDEX idx_flight_upgrades_flight ON flight_upgrades(flight_id);
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_flight_upgrades_key
      ON flight_upgrades(upgrade_key);
CREATE INDEX idx_payment_methods_user ON payment_methods(user_email);
CREATE INDEX idx_travel_credits_user ON travel_credits(user_email);
